phase: Complete customer addresses and automatic location assistance
scopeChanges: Shared matching added to homepage calculator, gas ordering, product checkout, combined checkout, service requests and saved addresses. Existing area choices remain editable.
Uses current API-supplied locations/checkout zones/service coverage. No external geocoder, GPS, postal verification, new DB schema or automatic operational coverage approval.
Exact comma-separated locality names, or locality plus Lagos/Nigeria suffix without commas, are supported. Other address formats require manual location selection.
